assertions.assertion: The claim was denied under code CO-197
The denial was due to missing prior authorization

The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome, raising concern for intermittent high-grade atrioventricular block or severe bradycardia
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
